articles.title: Trump Media wants to clear $884 million of debt without selling its bitcoin
articles.snippet: The Truth Social owner bought back $100 million of convertible notes this week. Holders of the rest can demand cash on Nov. 30, and its bitcoin is worth just under $1 billion.

articles.title: Tether invokes The Big Short in swipe at S&P over USDT reserve risks
articles.snippet: S&P Global made no downward adjustment in its latest Stablecoin Stability Assessment, as 5 is the lowest available score.

articles.title: Why CoinShares Just Sold All Its Ethereum and Half Its Solana
articles.snippet: The crypto asset manager sold $16.6 million in Ethereum and $2.7 million in Solana, freeing up $19.3 million. Here's why.
